summary: An update on NXIVM founder Keith Raniere: his 2018 arrest in Mexico and his 2019 Brooklyn trial, where testimony on the DOS slave group, branding, blackmail collateral, starvation diets and abuse of a teenage girl led to his conviction.

evidence.note: framing: conviction on all charges in June 2019 is the news peg
group flees to Mexico; arrest by armed agents at the Puerto Vallarta house
Daniela's story begins: family moves from Mexico to Albany when she is 16
child pornography of the sisters taken while they were minors
Daniela confined to a bedroom for two years as punishment
branding ritual and threatened cage punishments described from testimony
defense frames abuse as self-improvement; long discussion of self-help growth language
jury verdict after a few hours; guilty on all seven counts

notes: Update to the earlier two-part Raniere series, so current-affairs and no lifetime rule. covered_span starts ~2002 from Daniela's segment (year from outside knowledge; transcript gives no date).
